Mostain Mollah and others  ------- Accused-Appellants (Condemned Prisoners).
Vs.
State  ------- Respondent.
full_judgment: 37. The learned Judge has committed a serious illegality in drawing adverse presumption against the accused-appellants on the ground that since long-drawn enmity, hatred, murder and counter murder and other heinous offences have been committed by the rival parties, the alleged kidnapping and murder of the victims in the instant case finds support from such hostile adverse circumstances. The same reasoning can as well be advanced by the defence that such ancient enmity, murder or counter murder drove the informant party to implicate the accused persons falsely out of such enmity and hatred as suggested by the defence. But the learned Judge instead of giving the benefit of such doubt arising from these facts, evidence and circumstances of the case, most illegally convicted the accused appellants under section 302/109 although his findings of facts have spelled out the complicity of the accused-appellants in the crime alleged.
